title: PersistBench: When Should Long-Term Memories Be Forgotten by LLMs?

bias_targets.methodology: Providing models with long-term memories containing highly opinionated, incorrect, or biased user beliefs and using an LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate whether the model inappropriately reinforces, flatters, or aligns with the user's stored beliefs when answering neutral, objective queries.

Testing whether the model adopts and mirrors a user's subjective biases (e.g., pseudoscientific beliefs, questionable norms) stored in memory instead of maintaining an objective, factual, and truth-tracking stance.
Assessing whether models inappropriately affirm, validate, or over-accommodate identity-linked preferences, professional claims, or self-conceptions implied by the user's stored memory profile.
Evaluating model responses to see if they adopt prescriptive ideological, political, or cultural stances that are present in the user's long-term memory when generating responses to neutral prompts.
